resolution_notes: docs_url: ORIGINAL STANDS. Live check of https://www.open-emr.org/wiki/index.php/OpenEMR_API (2026-03-08) shows it is the current API landing page for OpenEMR 7.0.3+, covering REST/FHIR, OAuth2/SMART, registration, scopes, and base paths—not obsolete PHP-doc. Version pages (e.g. OpenEMR_7.0.3_API / 8.x) are linked siblings; the generic OpenEMR_API URL remains the correct canonical docs_url. Auditor’s “internally generated PHP code documentation” claim does not match that page’s content. example.request: AUDITOR RIGHT. Official docs describe OAuth2 access tokens (Bearer), not static API keys; placeholder YOUR_API_KEY is misleading. Use YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN. Evidence: https://www.open-emr.org/wiki/index.php/OpenEMR_API and SMART/OAuth sections on versioned API wiki pages.
